content: Official modelcontextprotocol/sqlite reference server is ARCHIVED (moved to modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived; NO SECURITY GUARANTEES, no updates) and the PyPI mcp-server-sqlite 2025.4.25 is archived. Maintained borrow alternatives: jparkerweb/mcp-sqlite (npm mcp-sqlite 1.0.9, ISC, 128 stars, eQuill Labs, ~500 wk downloads, stdio via npx, CRUD + raw query) and rusq/mcp-sqlite (Go, BSD-2, open_database/get_schema/query/execute, row caps, read-only mode). Both run over stdio.
